notes.subject: ol samting i kamap olsem tuking
notes.rationale: מופתים (miracles/omens) rendered descriptively; Tok Pisin lacks a single-word equivalent

notes.subject: cosmic signs
notes.rationale: Blood, fire, and smoke-columns are deliberately portentous, unexplained omens

notes.subject: ol
notes.rationale: Hebrew dual/plural on שמים and תימרות marked with plural 'ol'

translation: Na mi bai givim ol samting i kamap olsem tuking long ol heven na long graun: blut, na paia, na ol pilaia smok.

tokens.gloss: ol samting i kamap olsem tuking
